description:
Time and Venue:

Venue: SAGE Healthy Global, Thirumalai Rajapuram(Near Avadi railway station) Avadi, Tamil Nadu 600054

Job Title: HR-People & Organization Manager Company: Sage Healthy Global Location: Avadi, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India(Work from office) Position Type: Full-time; based in the Avadi office 
 Build a workplace where strong people join, grow, and stay. 
 Sage Healthy provides medical billing and revenue cycle management services to healthcare practices across the United States. Our Avadi team works with colleagues in North America to improve billing accuracy, reimbursement, and service delivery. Our people and technology underpin the quality and continuity of that work. 
 Position Summary: 
 The People & Organization Manager leads the full HR function for Sage Healthy Global, with accountability for recruitment, retention, rewards, recognition, employee relations, policies, and reliable HR administration. This is a hands-on management role that turns business needs into practical people initiatives and measurable improvements in hiring, employee experience, and team stability. 
 The manager partners with India operations, department leaders, Business Operations & Finance, and corporate leadership to build capable teams and support fair, consistent management. The role owns HR service quality and coaches or supervises assigned HR support staff, while maintaining appropriate confidentiality and approval controls. 
 Responsibilities: 
 1. Recruitment and Onboarding Agree staffing priorities, job profiles, selection criteria, and hiring timelines with department managers within approved headcount and budgets. Build candidate pipelines through local networks, referrals, institutions, and relevant recruitment channels; lead structured screening, interviews, and offer coordination. Own joining readiness and onboarding, including documentation, induction, manager handoffs, and 30-, 60-, and 90-day check-ins; track early performance and retention. 
 2. Retention and Employee Engagement Identify preventable turnover through employee feedback, stay conversations, departure feedback, and analysis by team and tenure; agree corrective actions with managers. Run a practical engagement calendar and short employee surveys; communicate findings and follow through on agreed improvements. Support career conversations, internal mobility, and a positive employee experience for office-based and remote India staff. 
 3. Rewards and Recognition Review market information and internal pay consistency; recommend salary ranges, increments, benefits, and incentives with Finance and leadership approval. Administer approved compensation review and reward processes with documented criteria, budget checks, and clear employee communication. Build timely, fair recognition for individual and team contributions, service milestones, and company values; monitor participation across teams and work locations. 
 4. Performance and Development Coordinate goal setting, probation reviews, performance discussions, and development plans with clear deadlines and completion tracking. Coach managers on feedback, performance concerns, documentation, and fair treatment; support appropriate improvement plans and escalation. Identify training needs with department heads, coordinate delivery, and assess whether learning improves job performance and readiness for greater responsibility. 
 5. Employee Relations and Policies Provide an accessible, confidential channel for employee concerns; handle matters promptly, document outcomes, and escalate sensitive cases to designated leadership or advisers. Maintain clear people policies and support consistent application across hiring, attendance, leave, conduct, performance, and separation. Coordinate applicable employment compliance, workplace dignity and harassment-prevention processes, required training, and records with qualified local advisers. Promote respectful conduct and embed Sages values: One Team, Excellence, See It Through, Courage, and Growth. 
 6. HR Administration and Payroll Coordination Own accurate employee records, employment documentation, attendance and leave data, benefits administration, and timely updates in the HR system. Validate and submit payroll inputs, including joiners, leavers, attendance, and approved salary changes; resolve discrepancies with Business Operations & Finance. Coordinate employee benefit and statutory administration with Finance and advisers, maintaining clear owners and calendars for required actions. Manage separations, handovers, employee communications, and final-settlement inputs; coordinate access removal and asset return with Infrastructure & Support. 
 7. People Planning and Process Improvement Maintain a practical people plan aligned with staffing demand, organizational changes, and management priorities; flag capacity and succession risks early. Standardize HR workflows and service expectations, delegate routine tasks where resources permit, and improve HR system use and data quality. Coordinate confidentiality and security training with relevant teams; restrict employee information to authorized users and maintain appropriate records. 
 8. Reporting and Accountability Provide a concise monthly dashboard covering time to fill, offer acceptance, 90-day retention, voluntary turnover, engagement feedback, and recognition participation. Track timely onboarding, probation and performance reviews, payroll-input accuracy, and closure of employee concerns and agreed actions. Establish baselines and agree realistic targets with leadership within the first 60 days; review results monthly and own corrective actions with department managers. Operate within delegated authority. Obtain approval for headcount, compensation changes, incentive budgets, policy changes, and significant employment decisions. 
 Requirements: Ability to combine hands-on HR delivery with ownership of recruitment, retention, and employee engagement outcomes. Strong judgment, discretion, organization, and follow-through when handling sensitive employee and management matters. Ability to coach managers, resolve problems constructively, and collaborate across functions and locations. Clear written and spoken English and effective Tamil communication for the local workforce. Availability to work from Avadi and coordinate with international colleagues as required. 
 Qualifications: Education: Bachelors degree in human resources, business administration, psychology, or a related discipline; a postgraduate HR qualification is preferred. Experience: Typically 58 years of progressive HR experience, including at least 2 years leading HR initiatives or a team, with evidence of improved hiring, retention, or engagement. Functional knowledge: Practical experience in recruitment, employee relations, performance management, compensation reviews, and HR administration. Local knowledge: Working knowledge of employment requirements and HR practices relevant to Tamil Nadu, with the judgment to seek specialist advice. Systems and analytics: Proficiency in an HR platform such as Keka, Microsoft Excel, and concise management reporting; ability to turn data into action. Industry exposure: Experience in medical billing, healthcare services, BPO, IT-enabled services, or a comparable service organization is preferred. 
 Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and role scope, paid monthly on the last working day. Annual vacation and personal time off follow company policy and applicable requirements. Bonus eligibility after the first year is subject to the approved scheme and employment terms. The role offers opportunities for professional growth. 
 Note: This profile outlines the principal responsibilities of the People & Organization Manager and may evolve with business needs. Management will confirm reporting arrangements, delegated authority, and individual performance targets.

Key Skills: Human Resource Management,HR Operations,Employee Retention,HR Generalist Activities,HR Coordination,Performance Management System,Corporate HR,Employee Engagement

title: Head of Managed IT Services India
description:
Head of Managed IT Services India 
 Location: Chennai (preferred)
 Level: Director / AVP
 Employment: Full-time
 Reporting to: CEO / Managing Director
 Team: Service Delivery, Service Desk, Infrastructure/NOC and People Operations
 Working Hours: Must have daily overlap with US Eastern Time (approximately 7:30 PM11:30 PM IST)
 Travel: 2 to 3 trips to the US in the first year, plus occasional travel in India
 About the Role 
A 10-year-old health tech company is building a new managed IT Services delivery centre in India to support mid-sized companies and nonprofit organisations in the US.
We are looking for a senior leader who can build this operation from the ground up, hire the team, set up processes, launch the first client, and then manage the business as it grows.
This is not a traditional IT operations manager role. The person will be responsible for building a high-quality service organisation that US clients can trust with their day-to-day IT operations.
 Roles and Responsibilities: 
 1. Build the India IT Services Centre 
 Design the overall operating model for the India delivery centre. Decide the team structure, responsibilities, working shifts and staffing requirements. Select and implement the required IT service management and monitoring tools. Set up the required office infrastructure, security controls and business continuity arrangements. Establish relationships with local IT service partners who can provide on-site support for US clients. Create clear service processes, escalation procedures and operating guidelines. 2. Build and Lead the Team 
The initial team is expected to include:
 Service Desk Lead IT Support Engineers Level 1 and Level 2 Network / Infrastructure Engineer Microsoft 365 / Intune specialist NOC / Monitoring Engineer Cloud / Backup support Service Delivery Manager HR / Recruitment support Key responsibilities include:
 Hire the initial team. Define job descriptions and selection criteria. Create practical technical assessments and interview processes. Develop an onboarding and training programme. Ensure adequate backup resources for critical skills. Manage employee retention, especially for US-shift roles. Build a talent pipeline for future growth. 3. Launch and Transition the First Client 
The successful candidate will lead the transition of the first US client into companys managed IT services.
This includes:
 Understanding the client's existing IT environment and processes. Planning the transition from the current service provider/team to the company. Creating documentation, operating procedures and knowledge-transfer plans. Conducting testing before taking responsibility for live IT operations. Ensuring the team is ready before the client goes live. Managing major incidents and escalations during the transition. Clearly defining what Aigilx will and will not support. Important: The candidate must be comfortable managing a client transition from the beginning through to stable day-to-day operations.
 4. Manage Service Quality 
Once the centre is operational, the Head will be responsible for service quality and client satisfaction.
Key measures include:
 SLA performance meeting agreed response and resolution times. Customer satisfaction (CSAT). First-contact resolution. Ticket resolution time. Reopened tickets. Successful IT changes. Backup and recovery testing. Major incident management. The leader will regularly review performance with US clients and take corrective action where required.
 5. Manage Security and Compliance 
The candidate must ensure that employees follow strong IT security practices, including:
 Appropriate access controls. Limited administrative access. Secure handling of client information. Regular review of employee access. No use of personal devices for sensitive client information. Compliance with applicable Indian employment and data-protection requirements. Experience with SOC 2, ISO 27001, healthcare or HIPAA-related environments will be an advantage.
 6. Manage the Business and P&L 
This is also a business leadership role.
The candidate will:
 Own the financial performance of the India delivery unit. Manage staffing costs and utilisation. Monitor profitability. Help develop pricing for IT services. Support proposals and presentations for US clients. Work with the sales team to win new business. Grow the operation after the first client is stable. Ensure the business does not hire significantly ahead of confirmed client demand. What We Are Looking For 
 Must-Have Experience 
The ideal candidate should have:
 Experience 
 12+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, IT service management or managed IT services. At least 6 years of experience managing an IT delivery operation serving US or UK clients from India. Experience working in an MSP, GCC, captive centre or similar IT services organisation. Experience building or significantly expanding an IT delivery team. Experience taking at least one client from transition/implementation to stable operations. Experience managing US-shift/night-shift teams. Experience managing service delivery, client escalations and operational performance. Technical Understanding 
The person does not necessarily need to be the strongest hands-on engineer but must understand the major IT areas being delivered.
They should have good working knowledge of:
 Microsoft 365 Microsoft Entra ID / Active Directory Microsoft Intune End-user IT support Networks and firewalls VPN IT monitoring / NOC operations Backup and disaster recovery Azure or AWS IT service management / ITIL Experience with technologies such as Fortinet and Veeam is useful.
 Leadership & Business Skills 
Look for candidates who can demonstrate:
 Strong people leadership. Client management skills. Excellent spoken and written English. Experience dealing directly with US senior IT leaders. Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills. Ability to manage high-pressure incidents. Experience managing budgets and operational costs. Understanding of utilisation, profitability and pricing. Ability to build processes and operating discipline. Strong documentation and governance mindset. Preferred Experience 
These are good-to-have, not mandatory :
 Healthcare or nonprofit IT services experience. HIPAA-aware environments. SOC 2 or ISO 27001 implementation experience. Experience managing third-party IT vendors/specialists. P&L ownership. Existing professional network/talent pool in Chennai or Hyderabad. Education 
 Minimum: Bachelors degree in engineering, Computer Science or equivalent.
 Preferred certifications: 
 ITIL Microsoft certifications Fortinet Veeam PMP/PRINCE2 is an advantage, particularly for transition/project management.
An MBA is an advantage but is not a substitute for relevant IT delivery experience.
 Ideal Candidate will be Someone who: 
 Has built and operated an IT services centre , rather than only managed an existing team. Is comfortable working with US clients and US working hours. Can communicate confidently with senior US stakeholders. Takes ownership when there is a major client issue. Builds strong processes and documentation. Can say No when a client asks for work outside the agreed scope. Understands both technology and business. Can build a team that eventually operates without depending on the Head for every decision. Is comfortable being hands-on during the initial setup but can gradually move into a leadership role. First-Year Success Measures 
The successful candidate is expected to achieve the following:
 First 30 days 
 Finalise operating model and team structure. Identify required tools. Create hiring plan. Prepare first-client transition plan. First 60 days 
 Key leadership positions hired. IT service management system ready. Shift structure established. Local service partners identified. First 90 days 
 Core team in place. Team training completed. Major incident simulation completed. Ready for first client launch. By Month 6 
 First client operating successfully. SLA and service-quality targets achieved. Customer satisfaction of approximately 4.2/5 or higher. Annualised attrition below 18%. By Month 12 
 India unit has clear P&L visibility. SOC 2 preparation underway. Second client contracted or close to signing. Delivery centre can operate effectively without depending on the Head every day. 
 
 Compensation 
Best in the Industry
US travel will be part of the role, particularly during the first year.
